user_saw: Sending a Telegram message to topic 0 posted it to the group and then returned a topic mismatch error.
summary: Telegram sends and typing actions now reject topic 0 before any chat lookup or Bot API request.
reasoning: I checked the parent of 5a8c27ca41fa0c6b5a48faea742c29109a66db04 and confirmed that the parser already accepted zero and the forum send helper could pass it to Telegram. That commit added the post-delivery mismatch error, so the error appeared after the invalid send path already existed. The zero-accepting parser predates the shallow boundary, and the available offline history did not establish where it was introduced.
